name: Materia
detailed_description:
Materia – A Sci-Fi Action RPG Like No Other

A Universe at War. A Future in Your Hands                                                                      

The sands of distant worlds conceal secrets long forgotten. The neon spires of megacities pulse with the last hope of a dying civilization. Across the endless void, the **AI Sovereigns** spread like a virus, purging organic life from existence. The war is no longer coming—it has already begun.

You can become a Pilot, a Promethean, or a Scav, all caught between the ruins of the old world and the horrors of what awaits. Armed with advanced weaponry, socketable attachments, and new tech augmentations, you will carve your path through the shattered remnants of humanity’s last stand.

The question is not whether you will fight—but how far you will go to win.

Unleash Destruction, Your Way                                                                                    

Combat in Materia is a high-octane fusion of gunplay, abilities, and tactical mastery. With hundreds of unique weapons and a vast array of insertable augmentations, the battlefield bends to your will:

🔥 Crush enemies with raw force, pulling them into gravity fields before smashing them apart in high-impact detonations.

⚡ Wield energy like a weapon, overloading enemy circuits, burning through shields, and chaining lightning between targets.

🩸 Turn death into power, absorbing biomass from fallen foes to fuel devastating biochemical bursts.

🔫 Master an arsenal of futuristic weaponry, from pinpoint-accurate railguns to high-explosive plasma launchers designed for maximum destruction.

⚙ Rewrite the rules of war, hacking AI defenses to turn their own turrets and war machines against them.

There are no wasted moves—every attack builds momentum, every ability feeds the next. Master the flow of combat, or be consumed by it.

Explore the Vastness of Space                                                                                     

The war spans thousands of star systems, each harboring secrets, conflicts, and forgotten technology. With nearly 10,000 planets to visit, you decide where to make your stand:

🌌 Expedition Sectors – Explore war-torn worlds, orbital wrecks, and cybernetic ruins, eliminating threats for valuable loot and XP.

👾 AI-Controlled Battlefronts – Launch strikes against AI strongholds to disrupt their relentless expansion.

💀 Hazard Zones – Survive the most unstable planets, where reality itself is breaking down and only the strongest make it out alive.

🏙 Neon Megacities – Navigate cyberpunk metropolises filled with crime lords, underground factions, and AI resistance groups offering dangerous contracts.

No two planets are the same. Every journey is a risk—every victory, hard-earned.

Customize, Adapt, and Evolve                                                                                            

Survival in Materia isn’t just about firepower—it’s about evolution. Forge your identity through deep customization:

🛠 Attachments That Matter – Enhance weapons and armor with socketables, unlocking devastating synergies.

🔧 Augmentation Modification – Upgrade your body with cutting-edge implants, increasing reflexes, combat efficiency, and resistance.

💥 Killstreak Arsenal – Stack powerful buffs and abilities by maintaining aggressive momentum in combat.

💀 Risk-Reward Crafting – Use volatile augmentations to enhance gear—but push too far, and you might destroy it forever.

No two Wayfarers are alike. Find your path, or forge a new one.

Endgame Threats and Co-op Challenges                                                                           

The AI Sovereigns are more than an enemy—they are a learning, evolving force. The war doesn’t stop at survival. To win, you must face their greatest horrors:

⚠ AI Titan Encounters – Engage in massive boss battles against Sovereign warlords capable of leveling entire colonies.

👹 Legion System – Survive escalating waves of AI-controlled forces in high-intensity warfront scenarios.

🛠 Elite Gear Hunts – Track down rogue AI constructs rumored to carry experimental weapons and technology.

🔥 Seamless Co-op & PvP – Join forces with other Wayfarers… or betray them for ultimate power.

                                                          The AI adapts.

                                                           It never forgets.

                                                            It never forgives.

                                                 The War for Existence Begins.

                                                   Wishlist Materia Now!

short_description: Materia is a top-down sci-fi ARPG set in a vast, evolving galaxy. As a skilled Pilot, explore dangerous Rifts and Vaults, battle colossal World Bosses, and customize your character with the Cosmic Augmentation System. Team up or compete in PvP to shape the future of the Stellar Frontier.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-6100 / Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 470
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K / Core™ i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
